_comment: SIM1: human-like settings for the sim bot (tools/wave_sim.gd, tools/bot_sim.gd). 'off' is the perfect bot and must stay all zero (the sim hashes assume it). reaction_delay: seconds between the bot deciding and the game seeing it (movement, aim, dodge, presses). aim_error_degrees: the aim is off by a random angle within plus or minus this, re-rolled every aim_resample seconds. cast_hesitation: extra random 0..this seconds before a card slot press.
